evidence.text: Pair production is evaluated with explicit helicity bases and initial-polarization averages at threshold. sources.title: Scattering amplitudes of massive spin-2 Kaluza-Klein states with matter

evidence.text: Coupling/mass sum rules follow from Sturm–Liouville completeness, mode equations, integration by parts and derivative-coupling identities. Radion identities also use scalar Goldstone completeness. Appendix E explicitly treats bulk fermions and states that scalar/vector proofs are analogous.

sources.title: Kaluza–Klein Schwinger Effect

evidence.text: Numerically integrate the Bogoliubov equations to evaluate ⟨N_n,k⟩=|β_n,k|². For the constant-field example, compare with the usual Schwinger estimate; use numerical oscillatory examples to illustrate repeated production and resonance.

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein tower thresholds and scheme dependence of the species scale

evidence.text: A factorized hybrid prescription uses Pauli–Villars regularization for single-mode diagrams and a proper-time cutoff for the tower. Propagators are combined with Feynman parameters before imposing the proper-time cutoff; the auxiliary momentum regulator is distinct from the provisional physical cutoff.
